results.title: ₹92,000, Gold Ring Stolen From Nursing Officer's Thar In Shivpuri; Police Probe Underway | Video
results.description: Unidentified miscreants stole ₹92,000, a gold ring and important documents from a Mahindra Thar belonging to nursing officer Shivraj Singh Rajput near Mahakal Hotel. CCTV footage reportedly showed three motorcycle riders and a suspicious car. The Voice of Nurses organisation demanded immediate police action, recovery of stolen valuables and arrest of the suspects.
